newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gourmet pigeon fancier admits bird bashing.
newsitem.headline: Gourmet pigeon fancier admits bird bashing.

text.p: A Hong Kong restaurant worker with a passion for pigeon flesh has pleaded guilty to causing the birds to suffer after he hunted them in a park with a bamboo cane, a newspaper reported on Friday.

"Chinese people do like pigeons as a dish. The reason he launched the attack on the pigeon was to cook it for dinner," lawyer Johnny Chan, defence counsel for self-confessed pigeon basher Chan Kwok-wing, told the court on Thursday.
"He insisted it was not wrong for him to have a pigeon for dinner, but it was wrong to catch it in such an uncivilised manner," the South China Morning Post quoted the lawyer as saying.
The 26-year-old worker had been stopped by park staff who saw him chasing pigeons with a bamboo stick. An injured pigeon was found on the ground, the court heard.
The worker pleaded guilty to wantonly causing suffering to a bird.
He has not yet been sentenced. Magistrate Alan Wright remanded him until December 12 pending reports.
